recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical composition featuring two men in modern western-influenced attire standing in the doorway of a dilapidated, rustic interior. The scene is framed by a weathered wooden border, utilizing a desaturated, warm color palette to evoke a sense of nostalgia and grit.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical placement of subjects flanking a central vanishing point
Contrast between clean, sharp subjects and a soft, decaying background
Textured, distressed typography integrated into the lower third foreground
Framing device using a physical border to create a 'found photo' effect
coreInvariants: Western-style accessories including a wide-brimmed hat and leather textures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two full-body subjects positioned left and right of center, occupying the middle ground and scaled to fill the vertical height of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central hallway receding into darkness between the two men.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the faces of the subjects, move down to the large-scale typography at the bottom, and then recede into the background hallway.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Limited; the composition is dense with architectural detail and large-scale text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated ochre and umber tones in the background and border.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark charcoal in the subjects' clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white highlights on shirt collars and cuffs to draw attention to the subjects.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark clothing and the light-colored walls.
paletteRestrictions: Limit blues and greens to muted, muddy tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab-serif and condensed block serif
letterConstructionRules: High-waisted crossbars in the display text
Distressed, weathered texture applied to the fill
characterSpecificRedesigns: Eroded edges to simulate woodblock printing wear
Subtle vertical gradients within the letterforms
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and color contrast between a large, textured primary name and a smaller, clean secondary title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif structure and western feel.
Provides the blocky, geometric serif look required for the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle shot of two men in western-style clothing (one in a black vest, one in a black jacket and cowboy hat) standing in a symmetrical doorway of a decaying, rustic wooden building. The lighting should be warm and moody with a central vanishing point. Apply a weathered wooden frame around the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, condensed slab-serif text in the bottom third. The main text should be ochre-colored with a distressed texture. Add a smaller line of white slab-serif text centered directly above the main text.

verificationChecks: Does the main text have a weathered, eroded texture?
Is the color palette restricted to warm, desaturated tones?
Is there a physical border framing the scene?

adjustableVariables: Level of decay in the background
Intensity of the sepia color grade
Amount of distress on the typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
Any brand logos or specific cuff embroidery patterns
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not obscure the subjects' faces.
Check that the perspective of the hallway aligns with the center of the image.
Verify the wooden frame looks integrated and not like a simple digital stroke.
Confirm the lighting on the subjects matches the environment.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a symmetrical architectural portrait with heavy, distressed slab-serif typography and a warm, desaturated color grade to create a 'Western Gothic' aesthetic.
